title: Mixed Event — Picture Perfect!

meta.Outline: When Kamiyama High School's very first Arts Festival is announced, Class 2-A decides to produce a film! It falls to Nene to sit in the director's chair, but will her leadership cut it?

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
Hey, An, check this out!
It's apparently one of the parfaits you can get at carino/carina...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa, that's gigantic!
I mean, just look at all the strawberries... Is it even possible to finish it?

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Three of us should be able to if we work together! We should go sometime since it's been going totally viral on TrickTrick!

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line:
Hey, Akito!
You free after school today?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, but why...?

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: I found this cool shop that I was thinking about checking out! I know you're busy with practice, but we need to hang out more!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This class is never quiet...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was hoping to do some reading before our long homeroom started, but I won't be able to focus with all this noise...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
(I guess I'll just listen to some music instead while I wait for the teacher to get here.)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Okay, everyone, take your seats.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, see you guys later!

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: See you! We'll talk again later.

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: So, what are we gonna do during the long homeroom today?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Oh, about that.
I have something very important to discuss with you all today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Something important...?)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Starting this year, we will be holding an event called the “Kamiyama High School Arts Festival”.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: An arts festival?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: As you all know, this school prides itself on fostering creativity and freedom of expression. Because of that, we're always receiving and coming up with ideas for new school events.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: For this festival, with creativity and cooperation in mind, the students in each class will work together to produce and present an artistic piece.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: These presentations will be ranked the day of, and we also plan on inviting a famed figure to serve as a special judge...

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Wait, a famed figure...? You're talking about a celebrity, right?! Who are you guys inviting?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Also, you said, “An artistic piece.”
Can you tell us a little more about that...?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Of course.
There aren't any strict rules to speak of...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: As long as you all work together with a spirit of cooperation in mind, you'll basically be free to do whatever you like.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: To name a few examples, you could do a play, put on a small concert, make a movie or perform a dance... Producing a sculpture together could also be fun.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We're free to choose whatever...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (A play or a concert... So I might be able to sing? That'd definitely get me interested...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But we all have to work together...
Not exactly my strong suit.)

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: This sounds super fun!!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! It's like we get to have another school festival!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yeah, I should've known they'd react this way...)

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
What should we do?
I really wanna make a film together!

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
Me too!
Making one as a class could be a way to make the most of our youth!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Youth, huh...? I don't know about that, but a film would definitely be memorable since it'll pretty much last forever.

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'm not hearing any other ideas, so let's make a film together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (A film...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Is it possible for a bunch of amateurs to actually make one...? It sounds like a lot of work...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hold on a second...
Making one isn't as easy as you guys are making it sound.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't know much about filmmaking, but I'm guessing it's gonna take a lot of time and effort. We should plan things out a little better before we decide.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yeah, exactly...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm... He has a point.
It might be good for us to appoint a leader, like a director. Someone with experience or who knows a lot about this stuff...

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Someone who knows a lot...

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
Oh!
I know the perfect person!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The perfect person? Who...?)

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
Kusanagi!
Could you be our director?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
You're in the film club, right?
And you perform in shows!

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: You seem like the right person for the job since you have a ton of knowledge and experience when it comes to films and acting!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Th-Thanks, but...
For the film club, we just watch the movies we have in our room...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Plus, acting for a stage performance and acting in a film are two different things. I really don't know if I could be a director...

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Really? But...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, hold your horses!
You're making her panic. We can't just ask her to do this all of a sudden.

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right...
Sorry, Kusanagi. I didn't mean to sound so pushy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
N-No, uh...
That's okay...

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: But I do think that you're the best choice out of everyone in this class to become the director...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: I saw you perform in a show at PXL a little while ago, and I was blown away by how good it was!

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: You guys come up with those shows all on your own, right? I figured if you know how to make something that amazing, then you'd be able to do the same for our film.

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: So, you don't have to if you don't want to... But will you at least think about it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Right.
Some of them have seen our shows.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (To be fair, I did help come up with a few of those stories, so I might be a little more experienced than everyone else...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But I've never made a film before.
Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The director has to get everyone to move as a unit while staying on schedule for production, right?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I-I'm supposed to get all these chatterboxes to work as a team...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
How do you feel, Kusanagi...?
Again, you don't have to if you don't want to.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I know...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Opportunities to lead big teams like this don't come around often, so maybe I should accept.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Also, I can't be afraid of working with new people...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We're gonna be working with other troupes moving forward... And my goal's to become a world-class musical actress.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I'll do it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It'll be a good experience for me...
So if you're all okay with it, I think I'll take the job...

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
Really?!
Thanks so much, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You're welcome...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (W-Well, I just agreed...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(There's no turning back now...
And if we're making a film, I wanna make it a good one...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I-I've gotta do my best.
For the sake of the festival...!)
A few days later
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A-Alright...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's begin discussing what kind of film we're going to be making for the festival...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
So, I'll jump right in with the first question.
Does anyone know what kind of film they wanna make...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What kind...? You mean in terms of genre?
Like fantasy, suspense...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... Picking a specific genre should help us narrow down the themes and make it easier to decide on details.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Right...
Then, I say action!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Like one of those martial arts movies where the main character beats up a bunch of baddies! Those are so cool!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That would be good...
But how are we gonna do all the stunts?

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: I think we'll be able to since a few people in our class are in related clubs!

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: Yeah, including me, we have three from the karate club. I'm pretty sure a couple more do judo and boxing...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, looks like we've got that covered...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay, then... We can jot down action as a possible candidate... Anyone else?

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
Oh, what about horror?!
That seems like a pretty standard choice! Plus, scaring everyone would be so much fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: H-Horror?!

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line:
Yeah, I like it.
I was hoping to do a haunted house for the school festival last year, but that didn't work out. This would really scratch my itch.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wa...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait! No! Stop!
We're making this thing together, so...I feel like it'd be a waste to do something scary!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, let's go with something more fun and cheerful! That'll definitely be better!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez, relax...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, we'll put a pin in horror for now. Any other ideas...?

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: I know! Something centered on a family, or maybe animals! We could make it a real tearjerker!

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line:
How about a sci-fi film?
One with a post-apocalyptic world and aliens and stuff...!

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
Would cooking work?
My family runs a Chinese place, so it'd be huge if we could advertise it a little.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
S-Slow down.
Please, one at a time. I can't keep track when everyone's talking at once.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, to summarize what we've come up with...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We have action, horror, something centered on a family, something with animals, sci-fi, cooking, coming of age, suspense, historical fiction, western and...

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line:
Oh, don't forget comedy!
I really love manzai, so I can come up with some routines for us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay... Comedy...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's nice how they've offered up so many ideas for our film...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But things might spiral out of control if this keeps up... We need to come to a decision soon.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: U-Um, so...! We have plenty of ideas to work with now... Next, I'd like to start whittling down our options.

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line:
Yeah, okay...
But they all sound really fun.

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
I know what you mean.
How do we choose just one?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, um... If choosing through a discussion is going to be difficult, then we can hold a vote or...

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: Wait, can't we just do all of them?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: All of them...? How?

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: Every idea was pretty good in its own way... So, why don't we just make a film that has horror, comedy, coming of age and everything else all wrapped up together?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (What's he talking about...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (There's no way our film's going to be any good if we take all those genres and...)

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Yeah, that could end up being really fun...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-What...?!

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: I mean, we'd be taking the best parts of each genre and stitching them together, right?

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: I've never seen a sci-fi-horror-action-coming-of-age-comedy film with animals before! This could be the most genius idea ever!

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: Yeah, it's gonna be an instant classic!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (A-Are they being serious right now...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Of course none of you have ever seen anything like that before... There's no way it'll feel coherent...)

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line:
Alright!
Let's make an awesome film and go win ourselves a prize or something!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(O-Oh no...
The ball's already rolling. I can't stop it...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(No, don't give up...
Things really will spiral out of control at this rate...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I need to step in...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
E-Everyone...
Please try to settle down...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, can't you guys see Kusanagi's trying to say something?

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, seriously, you guys want everything crammed in together? What kind of story is that gonna be?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Shinonome...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. He has a point.
I'm with Akito on this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why don't we narrow it down to one genre and then add what we can based on your guys' ideas?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Think about it! There are plenty of action films out there that have tearjerker moments!

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: True. Everything might be a bit much...

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Yeah. I guess we got a little carried away.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, that settles that!
We'll pick a single genre and then see if there's any other elements we can throw in!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How does that sound, Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, um... G-Great!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Th-Thank goodness...
They got everyone to agree...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Still, as glad as I am that we won't have to make the ridiculous film everyone was just talking about...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(If this kind of thing continues...
Am I really gonna be able to do my job as the director...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Then, we'll be making an action film for the festival.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cool! Alright, what comes next?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, umm...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: First, I'll take all of the ideas you guys came up with and draft up a script...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Once that's finished, I'll have you all take a look at it... How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! I can't wait to read it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And there's the bell. Let's call it a day.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, then... Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Th-That was exhausting...
Once they get all worked up, they just keep going. I couldn't get them to settle down on my own...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nice job back there, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh...
Th-Thanks, you too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Crazy meeting, right?
Everybody just talked nonstop!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Haha...
Actually, I really need to thank you guys for what you did...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What did we do?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You got everyone to stop and take a step back when we couldn't pick a genre for our film.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm the director, so I should really be the one keeping everything in order...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
We're all in this together, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, if they had their way, then that would've put us all in trouble.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Exactly.
We know being the director isn't gonna be easy, so we'll do our best to give you all the support we can...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If you ever feel that you need help, just ask.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks, I will...
After school
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (“Screenwriting For Dunces”, “Learn To Write Screenplays In Just 3 Days!” and “How To Start Writing Scripts Today!”)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Surprisingly, the school library had some useful books on the subject...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was hoping they might also have some actual scripts or screenplays, but beggars can't be choosers...)
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Aoyagi...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Are those references on screenwriting...?
We don't see those borrowed often.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, so... My class is gonna make a film for the arts festival.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Which is why I need a crash course on how to come up with a story for one.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I was also looking for books that include actual scripts, though. I wanted some examples to help me come up with scenes and decide how to present them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
In that case...
Please wait here for just a moment.
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Aoyagi...?!
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Apologies for the wait.
I believe you were looking for these.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The screenplay for “The Hundred Private Eyes”? And these are assorted collections for “The Flavor of Flounder” and “Mololo From Across The Street”.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait, they had all these...?
I searched for ages, and I didn't see them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That may be because they're not on the same shelf as the reference guides. I might actually bring this matter up during our next committee meeting...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks for getting these for me...
I'm on the library committee now too, for crying out loud. I feel so embarrassed about not being able to find these...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You just joined, so I wouldn't worry too much about that. You still have plenty of time to learn where everything is.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks...
By the way, Aoyagi, has your class decided what to do for the festival?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we'll be performing a dance routine. Akiyama and I are both in charge of making the costumes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I've never really sewed anything before...
But my classmates have been teaching me as I go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That reminds me. They gave me some tips on how to tie thread knots. I'm still practicing, but I should be able to master it soon.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's great.
Best of luck with your prep, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Let's make the festival a good one.
A few days later
Nene's Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Wow, the books Aoyagi found for me have helped so much. I have a somewhat better idea of what I want our film to be like now...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I still need to come up with the actual story and the characters. I'm leaning towards making the protagonist some sort of wanderer... I also need to come up with some enemies, and a reason to fight them...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(This is really hard.
I don't have experience coming up with stories that involve lots of action.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Plus, I have to try to include as many of the others' ideas as I can.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's see... What did they all say again...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
A tearjerker, something sci-fi...
Oh, an ad for her family's restaurant... I probably shouldn't consider that one.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The list goes on, but I'll need to think about them carefully since I probably can't include them all.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I didn't realize coming up with a story from scratch would be this difficult. I should've helped Tsukasa and the others more when they were writing theirs...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I might not be able to do this all on my own...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I think I'll head over to SEKAI. I'm not gonna come up with any good ideas while feeling stuck inside my room...)
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uhh... Where is everyone...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I can't wait to see how Tsukasa and Rui's class play turns out.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What are you all talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, Nene!
Hiya☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We were just talking about the arts festival your guys' school is about to hold!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Tsukasa and Rui told us their class is gonna be doing a play. So, Nene, what's your class doing?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, okay. I didn't realize they already told you...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
My class is making a film.
Which is giving me some trouble...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wow. With you as the director...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Cool!
That means you get to make all the decisions and stuff, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You're in charge of bringing everyone's ideas together and leading them in the right direction...
That's so wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah, it is☆
You've got a good head on those shoulders, Nene, so I'm sure you'll do an amazing job as the director!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You think so...?
I haven't been doing so well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, when we were coming up with ideas for our film the other day...

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: Wait, can't we just do all of them?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Things got really out of hand, which made me wonder how I'm going to do as the director...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I see. That must've been very challenging...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To be fair, there isn't much I can do since me and the others in my class have exactly opposite personalities...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Opposite personalities...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, um... Most of them have really cheerful personalities. And they're so outgoing... Basically everything that I'm not.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I feel this sort of wall between us since I don't really know how to deal with them...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is there anything we can do about that?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
What you just said is bothering me a little, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. She feels that there's a wall between her and them because she's the opposite kind of person!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I don't know what they're like...
But I don't think personalities have anything to do with this wall you're talking about.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You, Tsukasa, Emu and Rui all have really different personalities, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But you're all such good friends. There's no wall between you and them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, I guess you're right.
Hinomori told me something similar too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But I do shows with them...
I don't really have anything in common like that with my classmates...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree with what Len's saying...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I also see your point in terms of commonalities. Yes, you do shows with the others.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But that makes me wonder how you were able to become friends with Tsukasa and Emu.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That's a good question...
I guess by doing shows together...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's right!
Sometimes, people form bonds and friendships with one another before they have a chance to think about it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I don't think shows are the real reason why you were able to become friends with them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I believe it's because you got to know them better after spending time with them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Because I got to know them...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When I first met them, I thought they were way too eccentric for their own good...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it didn't take long for me to realize that they both had dreams they were working hard to make come true...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Before I knew it, that wall between us started crumbling away.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which tells me that your classmates should be no different...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, your classmates are probably just like Tsukasa and Emu!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
They all have their hopes and dreams...
They all like this and that, have their share of troubles and feel a variety of emotions...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I bet that wall you were talking about will disappear in no time after you get to know them better!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You might be right...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks, everyone.
I think I have a little better idea of what I need to do now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
Can I ask you guys about something else?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sure, what?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I'm supposed to write the screenplay for our movie, but I'm having trouble coming up with good ideas...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What?! You're writing the screenplay?!
That sounds really fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I've written everything down in this notebook, including all of my classmates' ideas.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was hoping that you could all help me come up with a good story...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, of course! Can you show us your notebook?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wow, so many ideas...
Oh, you've decided on an action film?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! Action?! That means...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Your main character's gotta be cool and strong!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A hero who helps those in need and fights to protect them... A hero who doesn't give up! Even when fighting against a really tough opponent!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I really love those kinds of stories!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Really...?
I didn't know that, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yup!
This manga Tsukasa lent me recently was like that. It was so cool!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. I see.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Then, the protagonist needs to be cool like that...
After that, all you have to do is start mixing in all your classmates' ideas, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You have “sci-fi” and “an ad for her family's restaurant” written here. Your story could take place far in the future... And the hero could be a cook! Who fights!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Wait, a cook...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds fun!
Then, the enemies could also be cooks, and...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I-I'm not sure how to feel about this...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But with their help, I might be able to get a synopsis ready by tomorrow...)
The next day
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Thanks to Miku and the others, my story's mostly all set now...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (There might be a little too much going on... But I guess that can't be helped since everyone gave me so many ideas...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Morning, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... M-Morning, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What's this you're reading?
Oh, could it be...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is it the screenplay for our film?! It's already finished?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: More or less... But I'm not sure you can call it that since it's still pretty rough.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, that's totally fine! You knocked it out so fast! Can I take a look at it...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Uh, sure...
I was actually planning on having everyone read through it later.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Awesome! Alright, how does it start?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are you two looking at...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, Akito!
The screenplay for our film's sorta done!
Wanna take a look at it with us?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, for the festival?
I don't mind waiting until later...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, come join us!
Kusanagi worked really hard on it, so we should read through it together! Here, sit with us!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I'm coming...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So, this story takes place way in the future...
And a series of disasters has led humanity to the brink of extinction...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Food has become scarce with the land now arid and no longer producing crops, causing great suffering.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Talk about a heavy setting.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: However, a number of the privileged employ cooks from the “Dark Culinary Society” to hoard all the food for themselves so that they can live in luxury.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
One man saw this injustice and stood up...
They call him the “Wandering Cook”. The freedom fighter who's sworn to make food for those in desperate need...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And so, with stomachs rumbling, the battle between the Dark Culinary Society and the Wandering Cook will soon begin...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This story's... Interesting...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, I get how you feel...
It sorta just ended up like this after trying to work in everybody's ideas...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I am recognizing a few that came up...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's amazing, Kusanagi.
You managed to get all those different ideas to work as a coherent story.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I'm not sure coherent is the right word... I asked some friends for help, but I'm still a little worried...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Don't be!
I think it's gonna be really fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I really love how the hero fights to make food for all those in need. That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Th-Thanks...
I'm really glad you feel that way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now that you've drafted a screenplay for us, Kusanagi, we can really get the ball rolling. What else do we still need to come up with...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'm still not sure about that either...
I was thinking that we should start by splitting into groups.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Groups?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, all films involve a lot of different people and groups working together. Actors, costume designers, cinematographers, prop designers, editors...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I don't know how we're going to decide the groups... It'd be great if we could have people with knowledge about those fields...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, why not just go ask?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
For example... Tachibana probably knows a ton about designing costumes!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Tachibana...?
She's the one who's always wearing a lot of jewelry and stuff, right?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The thought of talking to her never really crossed my mind since it feels like we live in completely different worlds...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, there she is!
Hey, Tachibana!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Huh...? W-Wait, now...?!
I'm still not ready to...!)

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: You called? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Whoa... Her makeup looks even more conspicuous up close...! H-How am I supposed to talk to her...?)

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line:
Oh, the director's here.
Is this about the festival?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
U-Umm...
So, we were just looking for someone to talk to about costumes for the film, and your name came up...

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line:
Really?! You can count on me.
I love designing clothes and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You do...?

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Yup! Gimme just one second...

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line:
Here, take a look.
It's a little beat up, but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A sketchbook...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, these clothes... Did you design all these...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(And there's dozens of pages...
She's even gone into really fine detail... Which fabrics to use, how to get these shapes and even the concepts for each design.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wow.
You designed all these yourself?

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Yeah, because I wanna become a fashion designer. I try to come up with new ideas every day.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And the teachers are constantly on your case about drawing stuff during class.

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line:
Hey, you don't have to go there!
I mean, An, you're one to talk.

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Anyway, ask me whatever you want about this stuff. I'll be more than happy to help...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Then, let me know once you know what you wanna do.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I see...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Tachibana is working really hard to make her own dream a reality.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: See? Why don't we go around to ask what everyone in our class is good at and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, that might be a good idea...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, then...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, everyone! Listen up!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
H-Huh?
What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're really starting now...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, it's faster if we just ask everybody at once!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's some things we wanna ask you guys regarding the arts festival. Do you mind helping us out?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Ooh, is this about our film?

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: Come to think of it, nothing's really been decided yet.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, in order to get it off the ground, we're gonna need to figure out how to film it and edit and stuff. I don't know how to do a lot of those things, so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We wanted to see if anyone in our class does.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: About filming...

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: Oh, I know a few things about shooting films and stuff because it's my dad's hobby!

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: We might have some spare equipment lying around at home. I'll ask to see what he'll let me borrow...!

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line: Like I mentioned the other day, since we're doing an action film, we've got plenty of judo and karate club members ready to help!

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line:
Not just judo and karate. Boxing too...
We've got a lot of skilled martial artists who've been training since they were little!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line: Also, this is a class project. It wouldn't be fair for us to make you do everything, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: I agree! We're sorry about not helping you sooner, so please let us know what you need.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Let's make our film a good one, Director!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, thanks...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's all do our best.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Yeah!
A few days later
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, um... Amisawa, do you have a minute? I want to ask you a few things about the film equipment...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm? What are you watching...?

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, this? It's drone footage.
The person took shots from a bunch of different angles instead of just from up above.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, and they took some really nice footage.

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: Isn't it amazing how much technology has advanced? Did you know that people started making motion pictures all the way back in the 19th century? It began with this device called a “cinematograph”.

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: Oh, sorry! I didn't mean to get sidetracked! Asking my dad about this stuff sorta lit this fire inside of me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, that's okay...
I can tell that you like cameras very much.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'm also really interested in that, but...
Mind if I ask about the equipment...?

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line: Hiyaaah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Soda, what are you doing...?

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line:
Oh, I was just practicing for the film!
I've been going to this one judo dojo for a really long time, and the kids there said they wanted to see our film.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I see...
That explains why you sound so motivated.

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm going to do whatever it takes!
Get ready for some really cool fight scenes!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'll be looking forward to those...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
T-Tachibana...?
You've been staring at me for a while now. Is there something on my face...?

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line:
Hmm... No, it's not that.
Hey, Director, wanna go clothes shopping together sometime?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?! Why...?

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: After watching you work, I kinda want to dress you up in some nice clothes, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: U-Uhh, lemme think about it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Kusanagi.
What can I do to become a better actor?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Wh-Why do you ask?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I tried recording a video of myself acting, but my delivery was a bit...no, really stiff...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wanna go all out, especially for the last part! Can you teach me how to sound more convincing?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I wanna learn how to do that too.
The cast needs to be on top of their game for this film.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Okay.
I might not be the best teacher, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Don't say that!
Please teach us, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A-Alright, so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We finally start shooting tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We've been really busy until today, but I've had a chance to talk to everyone... I feel a lot more comfortable around them now...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I hope our shoot goes well...)
Shoot Location

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow... This is where we're shooting?

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
This is awesome...!
Just look at those cliffs! It's the perfect location!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Amisawa's group found it for us.
It really is an amazing location.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We finally get to start shooting!
This is so exciting! You memorized all of your lines, right, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Of course.
I'm not about to make a fool of myself.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You sure are pumped up. But that checks out!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, to think that you'd be chosen for the lead.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I mean, we didn't really have a choice...
I'm the only one who's more or less the same height and build as Soda.

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line:
Sorry, Shinonome...
If only my acting skills were a little better...

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line: My brain and body sorta need to be doing the same thing, you know? My muscles do all the talking for me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get that.
Also, no one's good at everything.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: True... But the fight scenes are gonna be your time to shine. Do your best as my stunt double.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're also playing an important role, Shiraishi... The girl who the hero saves... You have a lot on your plate, but I hope you'll give it your best.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Will do!

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Alright, actors, once you've finished changing, please hurry on over here so I can start doing your makeup!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, gotta go...!
See you in a bit, Kusanagi!
se_run_women_003_1
se_run_men_003_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We're really gonna start shooting soon...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I've had to learn a lot of new things for this, but I need to do my best as the director...!)
Several minutes later

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: The lights and camera are all set, Director!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Now, the cast should be...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're good to go whenever!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (All ready to go...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We're starting with the scene where the girl gets attacked by the Dark Cooks and the hero comes to save her...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's also the opening scene, making it a really important one... Ideally, we'll get this right and set the stage for the rest of our shoot.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, everyone... And...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Action!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“Huff... Huff...
I'm almost home...”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “But I'm so hungry...”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“Maybe if I had just a little... No, stop!
Mom's sick! She needs this more than me!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“I'm almost there, Mom.
You'll get to have some food in a little bit...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Shiraishi's doing a really good job...
She's still a little stiff here and there, but she isn't hesitating. That makes her sound really natural...)

rows.Speaker: Dark Cook A
rows.Line:
“Hah hah hah!
Where do you think you're going, little girl?!”

rows.Speaker: Dark Cook B
rows.Line:
“Oh, what's this?!
Your bag is full of... Food!”

rows.Speaker: Dark Cook C
rows.Line:
“What a stroke of luck!
I guess this is what they mean by a duck carrying a leek!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “N-No...! You're...”

rows.Speaker: Dark Cook A
rows.Line:
“Bad luck, darling.
This food now belongs to the... U-Uhh...
The Dark Culinary Society!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Cut!

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: S-Sorry, I forgot my line.

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line: Yeah, and my voice sounded really shrill there for a second...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
N-No, that's okay...
This was our first take after all.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Still, what should I say to them...?
I don't think telling them to sound natural will help...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um, so...
Are you guys feeling nervous because we're actually shooting now?

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: Yeah... We practiced a ton, but this is for real now...

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: The thought of everyone at school seeing our film keeps overwhelming my brain...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Wait, what if...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, why don't we take some deep breaths and relax... After that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's try thinking about having more fun...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Fun?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. A lot of you are acting for the first time, so I'm sure you're worried about how you're gonna do and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I believe the most important thing is to enjoy playing your characters...

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: We should enjoy playing our characters...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... I know how you all feel since I lost sight of that once a long time ago, which didn't end well for me.

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I think I know what she's talking about. But for now... We should all try to have more fun!

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line:
Okay!
Then, next take?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line:
Break time!
Don't forget to stay hydrated, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Our shoot's going pretty well.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure how things were gonna go at first, but it's been smooth. I really can't thank everyone enough for...)

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Surprise!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Eep...!
S-So cold...!

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: Haha. We brought you some ice-cold juice. We had it chill specially for our dear director.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? This is for me...?

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Yeah, because you've been working the hardest out of all of us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I don't think that's true...
But thanks. I'll gladly have this.

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line:
Great! Also...
This drink is a small token of our appreciation.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It is...?

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: Yeah, because...

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: We know our film's gonna be amazing now!

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: We put you in a tough spot when we asked you to become the director, but it's coming along really nicely now, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Yeah, it totally is. Without her, this thing was probably doomed to become one of those really bad home videos or something.

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: Exactly. But you've been doing such an awesome job as the director... Our film's starting to look good, which is giving us even more motivation!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I've been doing a good job...?

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line:
Yeah, so...!
Let's see this through until the end and make our film an amazing one!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's keep doing our best. Together.
A few weeks later
Nene's Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We just have the final fight scene left to shoot. It's the film's climax, so I need to prepare for it as best I can.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh...? L-Len?
What are you doing here at this hour?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hehe. Remember that film you said you're making with your class? I came over to see how it's going!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, it's going really well.
Also, Len, you were right.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Huh? About what?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Remember that wall I talked about and how you said it'd disappear after I got to know everyone better?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Talking to them as we shot our film made everything you said come true...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They're all their own people with their likes and dislikes. I learned about the dreams they have, or that they like taking care of children...all kinds of things.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: After hearing all their stories, that wall startled crumbling away bit by bit, just like you said...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now, it feels like I'm talking to them like regular classmates...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Nene...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
